title: The Man with the Bag Teaser Out
excerpt: Official teaser for The Man with the Bag — premieres Dec 2.
body:
• The teaser for The Man with the Bag dropped October 13, 2026.
  • New movie premiering Dec 2 on Prime Video India.
  • It’s the most wonderful heist of the year

The makers of The Man with the Bag have released the official teaser, unveiled October 13, 2026.

For diaspora audiences tracking the film's US release, the teaser is the first real look at what's headed to streaming.
